# In a linked worktree git runs the pre-commit hook with GIT_DIR set but no
# GIT_WORK_TREE, so git takes the current directory as the worktree root. The
# hook must still stage the nested .sesam tree under sub/, not at the root.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

mkdir sub
exec sesam init --user admin --sesam-dir sub --install-hooks=false
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

exec git worktree add ../wt -b wt
cd ../wt
cp $WORK/newreadme sub/README.md

# What git exports to hooks in a linked worktree.
env GIT_DIR=$WORK/.git/worktrees/wt
exec sesam --sesam-dir=sub hook pre-commit

exec git diff --cached --name-only
stdout '^sub/\.sesam/objects/README\.md\.sesam$'
! stdout '^\.sesam/'

-- newreadme --
# changed readme
